title: Unit Event — No seek No find — Episode6 Illuminating The Darkness

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to perform at a new live house to take the next step in their journey. Saki writes a new song to play at the show, but it doesn't seem to resonate with the audience at all...

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What am I not remembering...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm... I dunno...
It'd be nice if I still have something from back then to jog my memory.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How about my correspondence notebook from school...? No, that only had the really important stuff in it, and my messages from back then have probably disappeared by now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Didn't I write stuff down somewhere?
Aren't there any memos or...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, I remember now!
I kept a little journal back then!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Originally, the doctor told me to write down how I was feeling each day to keep an eye on my symptoms...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see. It should be around here...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh? Aha!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'd totally forgotten about this, but this really takes me back. I'm pretty sure it's full of some really embarrassing stuff too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When did those memories take place...? I wanna say it was May during my last year of junior high...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I became really lonely because I had to transfer to this hospital that was really far away and I didn't know anybody there...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (My hospital room was so eerily quiet that I decided to turn the TV on to break the silence.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I saw Happy Everyday then and literally rolled around on the floor laughing...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But after the show ended, I had to turn the TV off and go back to being all alone...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I felt even lonelier than I did before I turned the TV on, and the nurse walked in a bit later.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(After that...
I heard those girls talking.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student A
rows.Line:
Haha!
The teacher was so funny that time!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student A
rows.Line:
Also, I can't wait for the school trip.
We should try sneaking out at night or something!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student B
rows.Line: But we'll get in big trouble if the teachers catch us.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
No fair...
They look like they're having so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Ichi said over the phone that they'd be going on their school trip soon too...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I wish I could go...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I don't wanna get left behind...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: They're all gonna go without me...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: All because I'm always getting sick...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: It's like I'm never allowed to be with them and make happy memories together...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Why am I like this...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Ever since I was little...
I've been in and out of hospitals all throughout elementary school and junior high...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I wasn't allowed to do anything “strenuous” even when I could go out and have fun, so that meant travelling was out of the question...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
And as much as I try to study...
There's no way I can catch up since I'm always stuck in a hospital room.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Even after working really hard to get into Miya Girls like the others...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I thought I could finally be with them and have lots of fun...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Why...?
Why am I so different?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I wanted to go on the school trip like anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: And be in a club... And stop by to get something while we complained about how exhausted we all were...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: That's why I took all those shots... That's why I took all those awful tests... They hurt so much...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
But I haven't gotten any better...
Tsukasa, Mom, Dad... I'm just a burden to everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
I hate this...
I hate this so much...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Why me...? Why am I like this...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Seriously... Why...?
I just don't get it...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Am I gonna be like this forever...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Stuck in some hospital room... All alone... And not even be able to go to high school...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: No... I don't want that...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I don't wanna be all alone...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Now I understand...
I get why this song hasn't been going so well...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was doing my best to not remember the worst parts of what I went through...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Because it would've been too painful...
Plus...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because talking about it would make everyone really sad...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A part of me must've been afraid of my song making anyone feel like that after listening to it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Saku's song went even further.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It dealt with what I was too scared of thinking about... It talked about that pain and sadness...)

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Saku's songs just have this way of getting to me.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah...
They always seem to find a way into my heart...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can kinda see why too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I have to write this...
I have to turn my feelings into music...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, the first verse can go like this. It'll sound like everyone's having fun during a long holiday... Except me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, wait...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: P-Please...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Don't leave me behind...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
(Huh...? A message...?
From Ichi...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <How are you, Saki?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <I saw a funny-looking cloud today and decided to send over a picture of it. Doesn't it look delicious?>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
(A cloud...?
Oh, here's the picture...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, she's right...
It looks like soft-serve ice cream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <To be fair, it'd probably melt in your hands since the cone's also white...>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Haha...
You're always such a stickler for those kinds of details, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <How's the weather over there? Is it sunny?>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
...
<Yeah, sunny but with some clouds.>
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
<Ichi.
I can see a little ice cream cone from here.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Really?! That's incredible...!>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
<We can have it together♪
So, let's dig in!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <It's very cold, so don't eat it too fast lol.>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I'm looking up at the same sky as Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: It's like we're sitting right next to each other...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi was there for me that time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(No, it wasn't just her...
Tsukasa, Mom, Dad...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even Hona and Shiho were there for me too when I was so sad and in so much pain... They always understood...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like they were saying, “We're right here. We're not leaving you behind.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That felt so warm...
And it made me feel so happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is probably why I was okay in the end...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna put everything into this song. The good and the bad. The happy and the sad.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know I'm dealing with a complex mix of emotions, but I've gotta dig deep...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I have to recall more...
The darker thoughts that lay beyond the loneliness I felt...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'll turn it all into sound...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It's finally starting to take shape...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! It's five in the morning...?!
I gotta get in some sleep before school...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'd have to wait until after school and band practice to continue working on this song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna keep going...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I stop now, I'll lose this momentum, so I'll just write as much as I can until I absolutely have to go to school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And put everything I feel into it...!
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, there you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Those bags under your eyes...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She came to school after pulling an all-nighter. Apparently, she decided to stay up after getting an idea for her song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure you're okay, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's nice to see that you're working so hard on your song, but I'm not sure pulling an all-nighter is really worth it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm totally fine!
We have tomorrow off, so I can sleep until noon♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, I absolutely wanna play this new song during our next show!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: During our next show...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We don't even know when we'll be playing, do we?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was planning on bringing that up today, but I was thinking about scheduling it about a month from now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's awesome!
A month means we'll have a ton of time to practice our new song!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mind if I ask how much progress you've made on your song...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
In reality, it's only about half done...
But I have a really good idea of what I wanna do in my head!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I just have to work what's in my head into my song, so it should be done sometime today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Today...?!
Wait, Saki, you haven't had any sleep, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you really need to hurry this much...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But in terms of our schedule, we might need her to since we need to practice it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We wouldn't have to for our usual stuff, but what Saki's writing now sort of differs from what we usually play as Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And since we'll be performing it on stage, I'm guessing we'll have to work on it a lot.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Sure, I understand what you're trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
B-But I'm okay with that!
It doesn't matter if our show's one or two months away. I'm gonna finish our new song today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My goal right now is to turn what I'm feeling right now into music...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm afraid that I'll lose my grasp on this image I have in my head if I wait any longer...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So I'll keep at it until tomorrow!
Once it's done, we'll practice it lots and really make it resonate with everyone at that live house!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: D-Don't you guys agree?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If that's what you want to do, you have my support...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: To be honest, I don't want you to push yourself too hard, but I can't stop you now since your mind seems to already be made up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I believe this is what's best for us. For Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you think, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's do it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, in return, Saki, if you start not feeling great at all, you have to take a break. Also, ask us if you ever need any help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you can promise me that, then I won't stop you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
I promise!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much...!
I'm gonna try my best!
